function getPrompt(string _promptId) view returns (tuple(string promptId, string modelId, address user, address computeNode, string encryptedPromptCID, string responseCID, uint8 status, uint256 inputTokens, uint256 outputTokens, uint256 createdAt, uint256 completedAt))
event PromptCreated(string indexed promptId, string indexed modelId, address indexed user, string encryptedPromptCID)
event ResponseSubmitted(string indexed promptId, address indexed computeNode, string responseCID, uint256 outputTokens)
event PromptFailed(string indexed promptId, string reason)
